answer: Decay reputation 12 percent per idle epoch and slash 40 percent of the bond on a failed audit. Set the audit sample at 8 percent of submissions per close. Price the cheapest attack at 1 clone needing 1 bond, 1 audit slot and 8 weeks of uptime before it earns 1 share. The canyon between that cost and honest work stays open only while decay outpaces reward. Quartz cut from one crystal shares one flaw. The zenith of a fake reputation lasts 3 epochs at most.
